statement.p: Design a rectangular milk carton box of width w, length l, and height h which holds 476 \text{ cm}^3 of milk. The sides of the box cost 1 \ \text{cents/cm}^2 and the top and bottom cost 3\ \text{cents/cm}^2. Find the dimensions of the box that minimize the total cost of materials used.

solution.p: The total cost of the four sides is (2hl+2wh)(1) cents. The cost of top and bottom is (2wl)(3) cents. Thus the total cost C (in cents) of the box is C = (2)(1)(h)(l+w) + (2)(3) wl. The volume in \text{cm}^3 is wlh = 476, so w,l,h are nonzero and we may divide and obtain l = \frac{476}{wh}. Plug this into the equation for C to obtain \begin{aligned} C \amp = (2)(1)h\left(\frac{476}{wh} + w\right) + (2)(3)(w)\frac{(476)}{wh}\\ \amp =\frac{(2)(1)(476)}{w} + (2)(1)hw + \frac{(2)(3)(476)}{h} \end{aligned} as a function of h and w. To minimize C, find the critical points of C by solving 0=C_h = (2)(1) w - \frac{(2)(3)(476)}{h^2} hence 1 wh^2 = (3)(476), and 0=C_w = \frac{(-2)(1)(476)}{w^2}+(2)(1)h so w^2h = 476. The quotient of these two results is \frac{1 wh^2}{w^2h} = \frac{(3)(476)}{476} so 1 h/w = 3 and h = \frac{3}{1} w .

Plug that into the equation w^2h = 476 to obtain 3 w^3 / 1 = 476 so w^3 = \frac{(1)(476)}{3}, h^3 = \left(\frac{3}{1}\right)^3 w^3 = \frac{(3^2)(476)}{1^2} and, l^3 = \frac{479}{w^3 h^3} = \frac{(1)(476)}{3} = w^3. Hence w = l = \left(\frac{(1)(476)}{3}\right)^{1/3}\approx {5.41371}, and h = \frac{3}{1} w \approx {16.2411}, centimeters.

Next we check that these dimensions minimize the cost C. At the critical point we find that C_{hh} = \frac{(6)(3)(476)}{h^3} = \frac{(6)(1^2)}{3} C_{ww} = \frac{(6)(1)(476)}{w^3} = (6)(3) C_{hw} = (2)(1)

D=C_{hh}C_{ww}-C^2_{hw} = (6^2)(1^2)-(2^2)(1^2) > 0. So, at the critical point, D > 0 and C_{hh} > 0 hence C has a local minimum. Since C has no other critical points, and C increases without bound as (w,h)\to (0,0) and as (w,h)\to(\infty,\infty), this local minimum must be a global minimum.
Therefore, the dimensions of the box that minimize the cost are w=l \approx {5.41371}\ cm and h \approx {16.2411}\ cm.
